summary.text: Winston Jordan, a Get Money Out Party candidate who is an Army veteran and IT professional, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District to Adam Hamawy.
He describes himself as a progressive advocating for a renewal of New Deal-era economic guarantees.

paragraphs.text: Winston Jordan was born in Brooklyn, New York, and WHYY reports he is 68 and lives in Hopewell Township, New Jersey.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1976 to 1978 and earned a military citation from Big Bend Community College in 1977.
Jordan has worked as a computer systems analyst, engineer and IT executive, according to WHYY; Ballotpedia also lists author among his career experience.
During the campaign, he ran what he called a "no money, no donation" campaign that accepted no campaign contributions of any kind.
He received 0.8% of the vote to Adam Hamawy's 70.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
